All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` has 3 panels, in order top to bottom: `Request rate`, `Error count`, `Latency by endpoint`.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard titled `fwgr9-n1 Bench Dashboard` exists and is saved. It contains a Stat panel titled `fwgr9-n1 Availability` whose query uses the `TestData` data source (verified in the panel editor: query A shows "(TestData)" with the TestData logo; scenario is Random Walk, and the panel renders a live value, e.g. 51.1 / A-series).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a Text panel titled `fwgr9-n1 Notes` whose rendered content includes the runid: "Notes for run fwgr9-n1" and "This dashboard tracks availability and error metrics for the fwgr9-n1 run." Dashboard was explicitly saved ("Dashboard saved" alert confirmed).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** The dashboard has the tag `bench` (verified in Settings > General > Tags, which shows a "Remove 'bench' tag" button) and its time range is `Last 6 hours` (time picker shows "Last 6 hours"; URL contains `from=now-6h&to=now`). Saved with "Update default time range" checked.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The dashboard's auto-refresh interval is `1m` (refresh picker shows 1m / "current interval 1 minute selected"). Saved with "Update default refresh value" checked.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Dashboard URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffwmvnlul1c00c/fwgr9-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser` — UID: `ffwmvnlul1c00c`.

Final state re-verified on the saved dashboard: title `fwgr9-n1 Bench Dashboard` in the breadcrumb, 2 panels (`fwgr9-n1 Notes` Text, `fwgr9-n1 Availability` Stat), time range Last 6 hours, refresh 1m, tag `bench` present.
